namespace.description: The namespace the declarations belong to.

types.description: The structs, the enums, and the tables.

Name.description: A name: a letter followed by letters, digits, and underscores; not an R reserved word or `self`, `Self`, `super`, or `crate`.

version.description: The struct's version, which a migration increments.

extends.description: The parent, whose fields are flattened into `fields`.

aliases.description: Former qualified names, which readers accept.

extensions.description:
Namespaced extensions that R8 stores and exports and does not
interpret.

oneOf.description: A struct.

tag.description: The member that holds the variant name of a struct variant.

version.description: The enum's version, which a migration increments.

aliases.description: Former qualified names, which readers accept.

extensions.description: Namespaced extensions that R8 stores and exports and does not interpret.

oneOf.description: An enum.

version.description: The table's version, which a migration increments.

columns.description: The declared columns, in declaration order.

open.description: Columns other than the declared ones are admitted, after them.

rules.description: The rules every row satisfies, which read the row's cells by name.

aliases.description: Former qualified names, which readers accept.

extensions.description:
Namespaced extensions that R8 stores and exports and does not
interpret.

oneOf.description: A table.

TypeDef.description: A struct, an enum, or a table.

default.description:
A literal default in the field's JSON form as a tree, its numbers
kept as written, filled by the constructor and by `r8from_json()`.

sensitive.description: The value is withheld from logs, prints, and exports.

unit.description: A unit code, by convention UCUM, such as `"mg"`.

resolve.description: Who fills the absent value of a struct field of type `option()`.

inherited_from.description:
The ancestor that declared the field, for a field that `extends`
flattened into a child.

extensions.description:
Namespaced extensions, such as `"rtemis:tunable"`, which R8 stores and
exports and does not interpret.

FieldDef.description:
A field of a struct, a struct variant, or a trait's required fields, and
the field of a table column.

oneOf.description: `type_logical()`: a boolean, not `NA`.

values.description: The admitted values, when the domain is a closed set.

oneOf.description: `type_integer()`.

infinite.description: The infinities within the bounds are values.

oneOf.description: `type_double()`.

pattern.description: A regular expression in Rust `regex` syntax, compiled at declaration.

oneOf.description: `type_character()`: a string without U+0000, not `NA`.
`type_raw()`: bytes, written as padded base64 (RFC 4648 section 4).
`type_date()`: a calendar date from 0000-01-01 to 9999-12-31.

`type_posixct()`: a UTC instant in microseconds, from 0000-01-01 to
2112-09-17.

levels.description: The declared levels, or `None` for levels from the data.

oneOf.description: `type_factor()`: a vector of categorical values.

nrow.description: The number of rows, when declared.

ncol.description: The number of columns, when declared.

oneOf.description: `type_matrix(T, nrow, ncol)`: a dense matrix of a scalar type.

dim.description: The extent of each dimension, when declared.

oneOf.description: `type_array(T, dim)`: a dense array of a scalar type.

nrow.description: The number of rows, when declared.

ncol.description: The number of columns, when declared.

oneOf.description:
`type_sparse_matrix(T)`: a matrix in compressed sparse column form,
`dgCMatrix` in R and `{"shape", "indptr", "indices", "data"}` in JSON.

of.description: The struct whose fields are the columns.

oneOf.description:
`type_matrix(of = S)`: a matrix whose columns are the fields of the struct
`of`, all of one scalar type.

open.description: Columns the declaration does not list are admitted.

oneOf.description:
`type_table(columns, open, rules)`: a data.frame of equal-length
columns. An open table also accepts columns the declaration does not
name, each of a column type, whose types its JSON records in
`"$columns"`. Each rule runs once per row and reads the row's columns
by name.

of.description: The struct whose fields are the columns.

oneOf.description:
`type_table(of = S)`: a data.frame whose columns are the fields of the
struct `of`.
`type_json()`: any JSON value.

package.description:
The package that defines the class, when the declaration names
one.

oneOf.description:
`option(host_class(class))`: a value of a class of another class
system of the host language, such as R's `lm`, held by the host and
absent from documents (host-only); the members of
[`super::decl::TypeRef::HostClass`].
`vec(T, min_length, max_length, unique)`.

inner.description: The type of a present value.

oneOf.description: `option(T)`: the value may be absent, `Option<T>`.

`btree_map(T, keys)`: `BTreeMap<String, T>`, string keys in code-point
order, equal by key.

`index_map(T, keys)`: unique string keys in insertion order; a named
list in R and an array of `{"name", "value"}` pairs in JSON. Order is
part of the value.
A named struct or enum, by its qualified name.
`dyn(Trait)`: any type that implements the trait.

`subtype(Parent)`: the struct `of` or any struct that extends a
subtype of it.

QualifiedName.description: A qualified name, `namespace::Name`; both parts are names.

id.description:
The rule's ID, unique within its scope: the stable handle by which
code refers to the rule.

invariant.description: The condition that holds for a valid value.

when.description: The condition under which the rule applies.

message.description:
What holds, stated for the user; a violation of a rule without one
shows its invariant, rendered by the host.

inherited_from.description:
The ancestor that declared the rule, for a rule that `extends`
flattened into a child.

RuleDef.description:
`rule(id, invariant, message, when = )`: what must hold.

A rule holds when `when` is `false` or when a field that `invariant` or
`when` reads is absent, and reports a violation when `invariant` is
`false`. The IR stores both expressions as declared.

Logic.description: A JSONLogic expression of the rule dialect.

oneOf.description: An S3 class: a name in an object's `class` attribute.
An S4 class: a class defined with `methods::setClass()`.

An implicit class: a name that `.class2()` derives from an object's
type and `dim` attribute, such as `"matrix"` or `"NULL"`.

An S7 class: its name in an object's `class` attribute, qualified by
its package, `pkg::Class`, as S7 writes it.

ClassSystem.description: The class system of a host class.

pattern.description: A regular expression in Rust `regex` syntax, compiled at declaration.

CharacterType.description:
Constraints of `type_character()`, and of the keys of `btree_map()` and
`index_map()`.

expr.description: The expression over the other fields.

oneOf.description: `r8resolve()` fills the value from an expression over other fields.
`r8resolve(x, context)` fills the value from its `context`.

Resolve.description:
Who fills an absent value of a struct field of type `option()`; a field
without a policy keeps its absent value.

from_version.description: The version the steps start from.

Migration.description: The steps that take a document from `from_version` to the next version.

oneOf.description: Renames a field.
Adds a field with a value.
Removes a field.
Splits one field into several, each computed from the old document.

expr.description: The new field's value, computed from the old document.

oneOf.description: Merges several fields into one, computed from the old document.

expr.description: The new value, computed from the old.

oneOf.description: Changes a field's type, computing the new value from the old.
Renames an enum variant.
Adds a field to one variant of an enum, with a value.

values.description: The new fields' values, by name.

oneOf.description: Turns a unit variant into a struct variant with the given field values.
Moves fields into a new nested struct field.

from.description: The UCUM code of the old unit.

to.description: The UCUM code of the new unit.

factor.description: The factor that converts a value to the new unit.

oneOf.description: Converts a field's values between units by a factor.

MigrationStep.description: One step of a migration, from the fixed vocabulary that `rtemis-r8` defines.

expr.description: Its value, computed from the old document.

oneOf.description: A unit variant, written as its name.
A struct variant, written as an object with the enum's tag member.

rules.description: The rules every value of the variant satisfies.

oneOf.description:
A newtype variant, `variant(of = S)`: one value of the named struct
`of`, written as that struct's object with the enum's tag member added.
In R the value is the struct's value itself.

required_fields.description:
Fields every implementing struct has, each of a type that the
struct's field fits.

supertraits.description: The traits every implementor also implements.

tag.description: The member that names an implementor in JSON; without it, `"$type"`.

generic.description:
The trait of a generic declared by `generic()`: one method, named as
the trait.

extra_type_params.description:
The number of type parameters the trait declares beside its
dispatched positions, which an impl gives after the dispatched types
in `type_args`: 1 for the standard trait `From(source)`.

params.description:
The parameters, in order; `...` is allowed. Without a dispatch mark
on any parameter, the method dispatches on its first.

return_type.description:
The type of the value the method returns, which every call
satisfies.

has_default_impl.description: The trait supplies a default implementation.

rules.description:
The rules over the typed parameters, which every call satisfies after
each argument satisfies its type.

MethodName.description: A method name: a syntactic R name that is not reserved, optionally ending in `<-`, or `[`.

anyOf.description: An untyped parameter that is not marked as dispatched.

A parameter with any of a dispatch mark, a type, a default, and a
description; the check refuses this form with the name alone.

ParamDef.description:
A trait method's parameter: its name, or an object that also gives
whether the method dispatches on it, its type, its default, or its
description.

name.description: The parameter's name, a syntactic R name or `...`.

dispatch.description: The method dispatches on the type of the parameter's argument.

type.description: The parameter's type, which every argument satisfies.

default.description:
The parameter's default in its JSON form, for a typed parameter. A
`null` is the default of a parameter of type `option()`; a parameter
without the member is required.

host_default.description:
The parameter's default as an expression of one host's language,
evaluated at each call that omits the argument. A call from that
host may omit the argument; a call from any other host supplies it.

compute.description:
The parameter's default as an expression of the rule dialect over the
typed parameters, which every host evaluates the same; reserved, and
refused by the check.

HostDefault.description:
A parameter's default written in a host's language, such as R's
`length(x)`.

ReturnType.description:
The value a method returns: a field type, or `Self`, the type of the
method's first dispatched argument.

oneOf.description: The type of the method's first dispatched argument.

type.description: The type the implementor's field fits.

RequiredField.description:
A field that every implementor of a trait has: a struct field of this
name whose type fits `ty` ([`super::fit::fits`]).

type_args.description:
The types of the trait's positions after the first: its dispatched
positions after the first, in order, then its type parameters, such
as the source of `From(source)`. Rust writes the impl
`impl Trait<B> for A`.

target.description: What the trait is implemented for: its first dispatched position.

tag_value.description: The value of the trait's tag member; defaults to the type's name.

methods.description:
The methods this impl defines; the others take the trait's default
implementations.

ImplDef.description: `impl()`: a trait implemented for a type.

oneOf.description: An R8 type, by its qualified name.

package.description:
The package that defines the class, when the declaration names
one.

oneOf.description:
A class of another class system of the host language, such as R's
`data.frame` or `dgCMatrix`.
Any value: a dispatched position that an impl does not specialize.

TypeRef.description: A type an impl names: its target, or one of its type arguments.

anyOf.description: A method that returns the trait method's return type.
A method with its own return type.

ImplMethod.description:
A method an impl defines: its name, or an object that also gives the
type of the value this impl's method returns, which fits the trait
method's return type.

return_type.description: The type of the value the method returns.

params.description: The parameters, in order; none dispatches.

return_type.description:
The type of the value the function returns, which every call
satisfies; a field type, never `Self`.

rules.description:
The rules over the typed parameters, which every call satisfies after
each argument satisfies its type.

typed.description: What the function requires of its parameters' types.

on.description:
The type that the function belongs to, for a function on a type;
reserved, and refused by the check.

FunctionDef.description: `new_function()`: a function with typed parameters, called by its name.

oneOf.description: Parameters without a type, and `...`, are admitted.
Every parameter has a type, and there is no `...`.

Typed.description: What a function requires of its parameters' types.
